tei:p.tei:seg: Thou art holy and Thy Name is holy and holy ones praise Thee every day. Selah!

And therefore put the fear of Thee, O Lord our God, upon all Thy works and awe of Thee upon all that Thou hast created, so that all works may fear Thee and all the created bow down before Thee and all of them may be made into one group for the performance of Thy will with a complete heart, since we know, O Lord our God, that dominion lies before Thee, that strength is in Thy hand and might in Thy right hand and that Thy Name inspires with awe all that Thou hashast created.

And therefore grant honour, O Lord, to Thy people, fame to those who fear Thee and praise to those who seek Thee and confidence to those who wait for Thee, joy to Thy land happiness to Thy city and a rise of fortune to David Thy servant and an array of light to the son of Jesse Thine anointed speedily and in our days.

And thus may the righteous see and rejoice and the upright exult and the pious revel with joy. Vice shall close its mouth and all evil entirely disappear like smoke when Thou removest the dominion of arrogance from the earth.
And Thou, O Lord, shalt reign alone over all Thy works on Mount Zion, Thy glorious dwelling, and in Jerusalem, Thy Holy City, as it is written in Thy holy word,
the Lord shall reign for ever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah!
Holy art Thou and awe-inspiring is Thy Name and there is no God beside Thee, as it is written,
exalted is the Lord of Hosts through judgment and the Holy God is sanctified through righteousness.
Blessed art Thou, O Lord, the Holy King.
